title: SB 1344 (2009 - Forty-ninth Legislature - First Regular Session (azleg session id 87)): elections; photo identification; address
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Bill text
(quote) REFERENCE TITLE: elections; photo identification; address
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) (a) A valid form of identification that bears the photograph, NAME and address of the elector that match the name and address in the precinct register, including an Arizona driver license, an Arizona nonoperating identification license, a tribal enrollment card or other form of tribal identification or a United States federal, state or local government issued identification.
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) Other forms of identification that are not listed may be acceptable as determined by the county officer in charge of elections and must establish the identity of the elector as prescribed by this section.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) (c) A current form of identification that bears the photograph, name and address of the elector except that if the address on the identification does not match the address in the precinct register or the identification is a valid United States military identification card or a valid United States passport and does not bear an address, the identification must be accompanied by one of the items listed in subdivision (b).
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona (para 2)
(quote) 2. If the elector does not present identification that complies with paragraph 1, the elector is only eligible to vote a provisional ballot as prescribed by section 16-584.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) (b) Two different items that contain the name and address of the elector that match the name and address in the precinct register, including A utility bill, a bank or credit union statement that is dated within ninety days of the date of the election, a valid Arizona vehicle registration, an Arizona vehicle insurance card, Indian census card, tribal enrollment card or other form of tribal identification, a property tax statement, a recorder's certificate, a voter registration card, a valid United States federal, state or local government issued identification or any mailing that is "official election material".
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1: Subject to the requirements of article IV, part 1, section 1, Constitution of Arizona, section 16-579, Arizona
(quote) Identification is deemed valid unless it can be determined on its face that it has expired.
(other) Sec. 2: Repeal
(other) Sec. 16: -579, Arizona Revised Statutes, as amended by Laws 2003, chapter 260, section 18, is repealed.
(other) Sec. 3: Requirements for enactment; three-fourths vote
